content: Mböör a Yɛsu
Mpal ayin, Sɛzar Angus kàtöm un'kaan ntɔn mutaŋ baar banswà u mɛɛn a Lɔmà.
Ntääŋ a baar atàtwɛb ayi yàkäl mpal kàkäl Kirinüs mfum a Siri.
Baar banswà bàkyeenà mukàsɔn ikɔb aba mbuur mbuur u bul kàfü nde.
Yɔsefi sye kàmbarà u Nasàlɛr bul a Ngalilɛ ntɔn mukyà Bɛtɛlɛm bul a Yuday ntɔn nde kàkäl mbuur a ywar anà mbil a David,
ntɔn mukàsɔn ikɔb ande anà kyà un'kyay ande Màlye awà kàkäl anà yöm.
Mpal bàkäl ba u Yɛlusàlɛm, taaŋ a Màlye mubɔr làkyer akwo,
nde kàbör mwan baal ande wàtàtwɛb. Nde kun'läl ipfɛy, waa kun'byee uboo a unkwak ntɔn ba bàmɛn anki ikal u ndwà a angyey.
Un'kyeey mwɛy kan'kàmɛnà akà aseey
U ntsü ayin sye aseey bàfabɔ̈ɔ̈nà u nsà uboo a an'ywaŋ muyiler in'kɔk aba u mpib.
Wɛɛ, le, un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàyàmɛnà akà ba, làkoo a Mwol sye làswɛŋ pɛɛlà a la. Ba bàwɛn bɔɔmà mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ un'kyeey kàtɛn a ba naa: « Twon lan'wem bɔɔmà, ntɔn mɛ amàlatwääl làsaŋ aŋàbwaŋ làyàpà un'sak akà baar banswà:
U mpib aŋàbà, u bul a David, bàmàlaböör Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ mwɛy, nde wà Klistɔ, wà Mwol.
« Bɛ làyun'man unsà idiim ki: mwan aŋàlal ipfɛy, wàŋàbyee uboo a unkwak. »
Kà imbürà, akyeey a du mbɔɔn waa bàyun'taan, bàmusà Nzam làkoo, bàmutɛn naa:

content.text: « Làkoo akà Nzam kà ikal a dudu, duu u mɛɛn uboo a baar bàfun'kwen! »

content: Aseey ban'kyà Bɛtɛlɛm
Mpal bàsawɛy akyeey ntɔn mufurà du, aseey bàtɛn ba a ba naa: « Tsweenà Bɛtelɛm bà, bi ikàman ndaa yan'bwà kwo, ndaa kàmisam Mwol. »
Ba bàkyen agyägyä, waa bàmɛn Màlye anà Yɔsefi, anà mwan akɔɔ wàŋàbyee uboo a unkwak.
Mpal bun'mɛn ba, ba bàsam ndaa kakyään un'kyeey ntɔn mwan akɔɔ awun.
Baar banswà bàweemà indiir bàtɛɛnà aseey, bàmɛn ndaa yubem.
Ndaa ayi yanswà Màlye ya kàkäärà u mpem, waa kàfayɔbà ya taaŋ lanswà.
Aseey waa bàfurà, bàmuyisà làkoo anà muyisyäŋà Nzam, ntɔn indiir byanswà bàwem ba anà bàmɛn ba, byàbü balàbal asànaa kakyään un'kyeey.
Yɛsu kan'wal ikɔb ande
Ilä kyànaan ungö a mböör, taaŋ mutsul mwan làkwe la, ba bun'pɛ ikɔb a Yɛsu, ikɔb kakyään un'kyeey kusà ngwän mukal yöm.
Yɛsu bàmàkun'swaŋ u ndwà a Nzam
Apan, taaŋ mupöŋ ndür làkwe la ntɔn Yɔsefi anà Màlye asànaa kàswɛŋà un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, ba bàsyen mwan u ndwà a Nzam a Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukun'swaŋ akà Mwol,
ntɔn bàsön uboo a un'kɔɔn a Mwol abà: « Mwan baal a nswɛm wanswà bun'sà ukɔl ntɔn Mwol. »
Yàlɔ̈m sye naa ba bàpɛ ibɔɔn asànaa ukalɔɔmà un'kɔɔn nsil awà, « nkokà un'kyay anà un'dim, itàkal in'tö a an'yem myeel. »
U Yɛlusàlɛm kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɛyɔ. Mbuur awà kàkäl wàbalàbal anà inzaam, nde kàfadilà mbuur ayàlwom ngyɛb a Isàlɛl. Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàkäl anà nde,
waa kun'kyään naa nde usàkwà anki kusà muman Klistɔ a Mwol.
Dweelà kun'syen u ndwà a Nzam. Umpal bàyàtwaal aböör a Yɛsu mwan aba ntɔn mukyer ndaa kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'kɔɔn,
Simɛyɔ kun'wɛl kà an'kɔɔ ande, waa kàsyäŋà Nzam, waa kàtɛn naa:

content.text: « Mwol, mpalàbà ngye an'kwey ilää angye:
ngye an'kwo awɛy un'tsüüŋ angye ukü a duu.
Ntɔn mɛ an'man Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ u mii,
Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ngye ntɔn in'sɛŋ myanswà,
Nde wà pɛɛlà ntɔn mupà kyɛɛy akà in'sɛŋ a mɛɛn anà nde asàkal làkoo ntɔn un'sɛŋ angye Isàlɛl. »

content: Ngɔɔm a Simɛyɔ
Taarànde anà ngwän bàkäl mubem indiir kàtɛɛnà Simɛyɔ ntɔn Yɛsu.
Simɛyɔ kun'si kɔɔ, waa kàtɛn a Màlye ngwän a Yɛsu naa: « Le! Mwan wà ayàkal mbuur ayàtyeey, taaŋ lumwɛy ayàmbaar baar mbɔɔn kà Isàlɛl. Nde ayàkal isi a Nzam iyàtwaal nkaabà,
abun an'kyän aŋàyee u mpem a baar mbɔɔn màsàmɛnà u leŋ. Wɛɛ akà ngye ŋakwo Màlye, usaay bàsapfuul mpem asànaa kɔm. »
Anà, ŋangɔɔm un'kaar
Kàkäl sye anà ŋangɔɔm un'kaar ikɔb ande Anà, mwan a Fanwel, mbuur a un'sɛŋ a Asɛr. Nde kàkäl un'nün. Nde kàkäl mbul nsambwaar anà un'dim kàbääl nde kà isyee ande,

ungö, nde kàbulà un'kweel un'dim. Nde kàkäl ayà mbul an'kwem naan aŋinà. U mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wanswà nde kàbwaayà u ndwà a Nzam musyäälà Nzam mpib anà mwäänà: nde kàkälà mukin mbɔr anà muyamà.
Nde kàyàkɔlà sye taaŋ nsil alan, wàmuyisyäŋà Nzam. Nde kàkäl mukyään ndaa a Yɛsu akà baar banswà bàkälà mudilà naa Nzam ukɔɔr Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mfuurà Nasàlɛr
Mpal bàmay ba mukyer ndaa yanswà kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'kɔɔn a Mwol, Yɔsefi anà Màlye bàfurà bul aba Nasàlɛr u Ngalilɛ.
Mwan kàkäl muyɛl anà mubulà ngwal. Nde kàkäl aŋàyɔl a an'yeerà, kɔɔ a Nzam làkäl anà nde.
Yɛsu u ndwà a Nzam u mbul kwem aŋiyweel
Aböör a Yɛsu bàfakyeenà Yɛlusàlɛm mbul wanswà mukàdyà Pak.
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu mbul kwen aŋiyweel, ba bun'syen Yɛlusàlɛm asànaa ikääl aba.
Mpal yàwü nköŋ, ba waa bàfurà, wɛɛ mwan Yɛsu kàsàsal u Yɛlusàlɛm, aböör ande bàyöb anki.
Ba bàsii naa nde wa anà atɔŋ aba bàtüüb ba mbwo, ba bàkyer mwäänà mwɛy muyikyà, waa bàsɛmà muyun'leŋ uboo a atɔŋ aba anà uboo a asam aba.
Wɛɛ ba bun'mɛn anki. Apan ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm mukun'leŋ.
Ungö ilä itär ba bun'mɛn u ndwà a Nzam kàkyàbwaay uboboo a alɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn. Nde kàkäl muweemà ba anà musà ba mfuul.
Baar banswà bàweemà ndaa ande bàkäl mubem ntɔn un'yɛnà ande anà mfuur a ndaa ande.
Mpal bun'mɛn aböör ande, ba bàkyer abem, lalan ngwän kàtɛn nde a nde naa: « Mwan amɛ, ntɔn nkye amà ikyer ngye abà? Ler, taaràŋà anà mɛ, bi kan'kyɛɛr mbɔɔn muyaleŋ. »
Nde waa kafuur naa: « Ntɔn nkye làyan'leŋ bɛ? Bɛ làyöb anki naa mɛ in'kyer akyer isal a taaràmɛ? »
Wɛɛ ba bàsàyöb anki ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde.
Apan Yɛsu kàfurà Nasàlɛr anà ba. Nde kàkyer afalabà ndaa aba. Ndaa ayi yanswà ngwän ya kàkäärà u mpem ande.
Yɛsu kàkäl muyɛl unsà ndür anà unsà an'yeerà. Nde sye kàpɛɛ un'sak akà Nzam anà akà baar.
